states.supported: A clean consumer installs the documented artifact and executes a real Lean component.
states.partial: Package or interface behavior passes, but an ordinary package workflow remains incomplete.
states.blocked: CI verifies the missing capability and the documentation does not claim support.

consumers.name: JavaScript on Node
consumers.scope: Node 22 ESM with separate generated runtime and component npm archives

consumers.name: TypeScript on Node
consumers.scope: TypeScript 5.9 strict compilation to Node 22 ESM

consumers.name: Browser JavaScript
consumers.scope: Raw ESM, module worker, Vite, Rollup, Webpack, and React fixture execution
consumers.blocker: The npm package has no browser conditional export, so an installed package resolves its Node entry point.

consumers.name: Native PHP
consumers.scope: PHP 8.2 NTS on x86-64 Linux through the generated Zend extension

consumers.name: PHP-Wasm
consumers.scope: PHP 8.4 in the Node-hosted php-wasm 0.1.0 runtime, lazy and startup profiles

consumers.name: Python
consumers.scope: Generated Python package and PyPI projection
consumers.blocker: The canonical bundle has no native component library or Python extension adapter.

consumers.name: Rust
consumers.scope: Generated Rust crate and Cargo projection
consumers.blocker: The canonical bundle has no native component library or Rust runtime adapter.

consumers.name: C
consumers.scope: Generated C11 sources and C package projection
consumers.blocker: The canonical bundle has no native component library.

consumers.name: C++
consumers.blocker: The canonical bundle has no native component library or generated C++ binding projection.

consumers.name: WIT/WASI
consumers.scope: Generated WIT interface and nominal resource composition
consumers.blocker: The build has no Component Model binary adapter or WASI execution path.
